Q: How can Privacy Display on Galaxy S26 Ultra help me?
A: If you're worried about people being able to view your personal information when you're in a crowded space, you can activate Privacy Display to hide your full screen from others.
Q: What has improved in the Galaxy S26 Ultra's camera compared to the Galaxy S25 Ultra?
A: Wider apertures mean the 200 MP Wide camera opens to F1.4. The 50 MP Telephoto camera, with 5x optical zoom and 10x optical quality zoom, now opens to F2.9. This allows in more light for improved brightness.
Q: What's the new key AI feature available on Galaxy S26 Ultra?
A: Now Nudge is a new feature that intelligently understands what's on your screen and will provide suggestions, such as viewing your ‘Calendar’ to add an event or the option to jump straight to your ‘Gallery’ when someone asks you to share photos with them.
Q: Which messaging apps are supported by Now Nudge?
A: Text message prompts are currently available with Samsung Messages and certain third-party messaging apps including Google Messages and Google Chat. Based on availability at the time of product launch. May change without notice.
